svg.title: Tyflix system map
svg.desc: The browser reaches Tyflix through the Cloudflare edge and an outbound-only cloudflared tunnel. Tyflix calls Plex, Seerr, Sonarr, TMDB, a metrics service and, optionally, Transmission. Video is the exception: it streams directly from Plex to the browser, bypassing the tunnel entirely.
svg.text: Video only: direct HTTPS, never touches the tunnel
